buyer_portal.headline: Every room touched, on 1.11 acres in Carriage Hill.
buyer_portal.description: A traditional Colonial on a beautiful 1.11-acre lot in Carriage Hill, one of Vienna’s most sought-after neighborhoods — thoughtfully and beautifully updated throughout, blending timeless character with modern finishes. Hardwood flooring spans all three finished levels. The main level is anchored by an updated, open eat-in kitchen with a cozy family room and fireplace on one side and an elegant dining room on the other, with a formal living room, private office, powder room, and a mudroom with laundry and access to the oversized two-car garage. Upstairs are four generously sized bedrooms, including a primary suite with a completely modernized en-suite bath; bedrooms two, three and four share a separate, beautifully updated full hall bath. The walkout lower level was made for entertaining — a spacious recreation room with a game area, bar and full bath, a large fitness room and a fifth bedroom. Every room has been refreshed, with an extensive list of improvements inside and out: the work has already been done.
highlights: Hardwood across all three finished levels
Walkout lower level built for entertaining

feature_headlines.head: Knock-Your-Socks-Off from the Moment You Arrive
sub: No detail has been spared and every room has been touched. Hardwood flooring spans all three finished levels, and the warmth and quality are immediately apparent as you step from the covered front porch into the welcoming foyer.

feature_headlines.head: An Open Eat-In Kitchen at the Centre of the Main Level
sub: A cozy family room and fireplace on one side, an elegant dining room on the other, plus a formal living room, private office, powder room and a mudroom with laundry and tons of storage.

feature_headlines.head: A Walkout Lower Level Made for Entertaining
sub: A spacious recreation room with a game area, bar and full bath, a large fitness room, a fifth bedroom and tons of storage.

feature_headlines.head: Two Covered Brick Patios and a High-End Jacuzzi
sub: An upper patio directly off the kitchen with a built-in gas grill, and a large Jacuzzi just outside the walkout lower level. The brick was selected to match the home.
